facebookresearch_pyrobot/pyrobot_bridge/.set_joint_positions: set robot joint positions by computing and executing a MoveIt trajectory plan
facebookresearch_pyrobot/pyrobot_bridge/.move_ee_xyz: move the robot end effector along XYZ waypoints using cartesian path planning
